story.title: Priya's New School
paragraphs_en: Today is Priya's first day of school! She just moved from California to New Jersey. She is going into 2nd grade. She is so excited to visit her new school and make new friends. Priya's older brother, Rahul, told her that 2nd grade is very fun! "Priya come downstairs for breakfast." "Coming Amma!" Priya put on her blue cap and went downstairs.

Rahul and Amma were sitting at the table. "Where is nana?" Priya asks. "He is at work," Rahul says. Priya smells pancakes. It smells delicious. Priya sits at the table and quickly eats all of her food. She takes her backpack and walks to the bus stop.

When Priya gets on the bus she sees everybody talking to each other. She notices that everyone already has friends from last year. She is scared that nobody will want to be friends with her because she is new. "Hi my name is Priya. Can I sit next to you?" Priya asks a girl. "NO WAY! This seat is saved for my BFF Moana!" Shouts the girl. Priya sits alone in the back of the bus. She is sad. She thinks that she will never make any friends. When Priya arrives at school she does not know where to go. Everybody else has already been to this school last year so they all know where to go. "Excuse me. Where is Mr. Mick's classroom?" Priya says stopping a boy. The boy looks at her and then runs to his class. Priya is upset.

"HI! I am Mr. Mick. I have never seen you around before. You must be the new student Priya." "Yeah,"Priya says. "Everyone settle down. I would like you to meet the new student Priya." Everyone stared at Priya. "Ok class lets start learning. Can anybody tell me what 12 plus 67 is? How about you Priya." "Um, 84?" The entire class chuckled because of the wrong answer to the easy problem. Priya put her blue cap over her eyes so nobody could see the tears in her eyes. Priya had no friends, her entire class thought she was a joke, and her teacher thought she was dumb. This was going to be the worst year ever. Priya sat alone at lunch and swung by herself at recess. Finally she got home.

"How was school Priya?" Rahul asked. Priya ignored him and ran to her room. She shut the door and cried. Priya thought that her class did not like her, but maybe during lunch she could become friends with a kid from another class. Priya though that that was a good idea. She decided that tomorrow she would make a bunch of friends during lunch.

Priya woke up. She put on a pink sweater and a white skirt. Then she put on a pink headband and white bunny slippers. Priya was ready to make some new friends at lunch. The first 3 hours of the day passed. It was finally lunch time. Priya took her lunch box and went to get a spoon for her fried rice. As she was walking to the lunch table she slipped and fell. The entire school looked at her and started laughing. Now everyone hated her. Priya is mad and sad.

When Priya went home she went to amma. "Amma, I am never EVER going to school again!" "Why Priya? You don't have a choice you have to go." "UGHH!" Priya was so mad. She went to her room and cried. She wished she had never moved. She like her old school and her old friends. Now she didn't even have any friends.

The next few days of school passed. Priya still had no friends. Everyday during lunch Priya would sit alone in the back of the room, and during recess she would walk around the playground watching the other kids play. During her classes she sat in the back of the room with her head down, never raising her hand. She never talked to her brother or her parents. When she went home she sat in her room staring at the wall.

"Priya!" "Yes?" "You have mail!" "I don't care." "Come and read it." "No!" "Rahul!" "What ma? "Give this mail to your sister." "Ok." Rahul came to Priya's room and gave her the mail. Priya opened the letter. Hi Priya, How are you? I have seen you around at school. I see that you don't have that many friends. Don't worry about the mean people in school! You can sit with us from tomorrow! :) Kavya

Priya was so happy, because of the letter. Then she thought that why would anybody ever give her a nice letter after she was so clumsy and horrible at school. She decided to ask Kavya. Dear Kavya, Thank you for the letter. I was wondering why are you being so kind to me after I was nothing but miserable and clumsy at school? - Priya

Priya, I wrote the letter because I wanted to be a kind person. You should always remember that no matter how mean or miserable other people are you should look for the good in them and help them. Remember to be the best person you can be and never give up. I can't wait to see you in school tomorrow. - Kavya

Priya was so happy. She learned something very important from Kavya. She new that she was going to have the best year ever. She did not know if she would like Kavya's friends, or if her teachers would like her, but now she knew that no matter what she was not going to give up and she was going to be the kindest person ever, just like Kavya was to her. Dear Kavya, Thank you for being my friend. - Priya

items.text_en: Today is Priya's first day of school!
She just moved from California to New Jersey.
She is going into 2nd grade.
She is so excited to visit her new school and make new friends.
Priya's older brother, Rahul, told her that 2nd grade is very fun!
"Priya come downstairs for breakfast." "Coming Amma!" Priya put on her blue cap and went downstairs.
Rahul and Amma were sitting at the table.
"Where is nana?" Priya asks.
"He is at work," Rahul says.
Priya smells pancakes.
It smells delicious.
Priya sits at the table and quickly eats all of her food.
She takes her backpack and walks to the bus stop.
When Priya gets on the bus she sees everybody talking to each other.
She notices that everyone already has friends from last year.
She is scared that nobody will want to be friends with her because she is new.
"Hi my name is Priya.
Can I sit next to you?" Priya asks a girl.
"NO WAY! This seat is saved for my BFF Moana!" Shouts the girl.
Priya sits alone in the back of the bus.
She is sad.
She thinks that she will never make any friends.
When Priya arrives at school she does not know where to go.
Everybody else has already been to this school last year so they all know where to go.
"Excuse me. Where is Mr.
Mick's classroom?" Priya says stopping a boy.
The boy looks at her and then runs to his class.
Priya is upset.
"HI! I am Mr.
Mick. I have never seen you around before.
You must be the new student Priya." "Yeah,"Priya says.
"Everyone settle down.
I would like you to meet the new student Priya." Everyone stared at Priya.
"Ok class lets start learning.
Can anybody tell me what 12 plus 67 is?
How about you Priya." "Um, 84?" The entire class chuckled because of the wrong answer to the easy problem.
Priya put her blue cap over her eyes so nobody could see the tears in her eyes.
Priya had no friends, her entire class thought she was a joke, and her teacher thought she was dumb.
This was going to be the worst year ever.
Priya sat alone at lunch and swung by herself at recess.
Finally she got home.
"How was school Priya?" Rahul asked.
Priya ignored him and ran to her room.
She shut the door and cried.
Priya thought that her class did not like her, but maybe during lunch she could become friends with a kid from another class.
Priya though that that was a good idea.
She decided that tomorrow she would make a bunch of friends during lunch.
Priya woke up.
She put on a pink sweater and a white skirt.
Then she put on a pink headband and white bunny slippers.
Priya was ready to make some new friends at lunch.
The first 3 hours of the day passed.
It was finally lunch time.
Priya took her lunch box and went to get a spoon for her fried rice.
As she was walking to the lunch table she slipped and fell.
The entire school looked at her and started laughing.
Now everyone hated her.
Priya is mad and sad.
When Priya went home she went to amma.
"Amma, I am never EVER going to school again!" "Why Priya?
You don't have a choice you have to go." "UGHH!" Priya was so mad.
She went to her room and cried.
She wished she had never moved.
She like her old school and her old friends.
Now she didn't even have any friends.
The next few days of school passed.
Priya still had no friends.
Everyday during lunch Priya would sit alone in the back of the room, and during recess she would walk around the playground watching the other kids play.
During her classes she sat in the back of the room with her head down, never raising her hand.
She never talked to her brother or her parents.
When she went home she sat in her room staring at the wall.
"Priya!" "Yes?" "You have mail!" "I don't care." "Come and read it." "No!" "Rahul!" "What ma?
"Give this mail to your sister." "Ok." Rahul came to Priya's room and gave her the mail.
Priya opened the letter.
Hi Priya, How are you?
I have seen you around at school.
I see that you don't have that many friends.
Don't worry about the mean people in school!
You can sit with us from tomorrow! :) Kavya
Priya was so happy, because of the letter.
Then she thought that why would anybody ever give her a nice letter after she was so clumsy and horrible at school.
She decided to ask Kavya.
Dear Kavya, Thank you for the letter.
I was wondering why are you being so kind to me after I was nothing but miserable and clumsy at school? - Priya
Priya, I wrote the letter because I wanted to be a kind person.
You should always remember that no matter how mean or miserable other people are you should look for the good in them and help them.
Remember to be the best person you can be and never give up.
I can't wait to see you in school tomorrow. - Kavya
Priya was so happy.
She learned something very important from Kavya.
She new that she was going to have the best year ever.

She did not know if she would like Kavya's friends, or if her teachers would like her, but now she knew that no matter what she was not going to give up and she was going to be the kindest person ever, just like Kavya was to her.
Dear Kavya, Thank you for being my friend. - Priya
